description.value: BC Liquor Store is a provincial government-operated retail outlet selling wine, beer, spirits, coolers, and ciders, forming part of the 198-location BCLIQUOR chain. This South Burnaby location is a standard chain store with a broad product selection and knowledgeable staff for beverage recommendations. A touring cyclist could stop to pick up packaged alcoholic beverages, but the store offers no food, prepared drinks, or documented cyclist services.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (8 spaces, covered) at 92m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: OSM identifies this as a BC Liquor Store (government-operated chain) at 4429 Kingsway, Unit 16, South Burnaby. The website confirms it is a BCLIQUOR retail location selling wine, beer, spirits, and related products, with no mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cyclist-oriented amenity in either the OSM tags or the website content. As a large chain retail liquor store with none of the WWC required criteria confirmable, it does not fit the spirit of the WWC cycling tourism directory.
